services.desc: Great! Our certified instructors are ready to strap themselves to you for the ride. We've got your back- literally! So sit back and keep scrolling to learn more! Skydive Philadelphia uses the highest quality skydiving equipment and our staff are some of the best in the business. Not only that, we offer breathtaking views of both the Philadelphia and New York skyline, as well as Nockamixon State Park located nearby! Over 20 years of experience. We maintain the Highest Quality Equipment and each of our Instructors are U.S. Parachute Association Certified. See for yourself why Skydive Philadelphia is the best skydiving facilities in the Northeast! Check out our reviews

quotes.text: I couldn’t be happier with my choice! I was very nervous as expect since I had never done it in the past which is normal. I trusted the team members, specially TIM who’s knowledgeable when it comes to this incredible aventure. I must say, he made me feel safe before jumping off the plane. “He said I got you buddy” for anyone who’s planning on doing it for the first time man just go for it because you’re not going to be 100 sure no way specially when doing something you had never done. Do it while you can because the older we get the scary we get.

My friend and I went skydiving for the first time here yesterday and it was an 11/10 experience for both of us! We had midterms at 5pm and jumped at 1, the staff here were accommodating, friendly, and made the experience extremely fun! Chris, Tim, Darren, and Joe were the team my friend and I jumped with and we got so lucky! I have recommended personal friends to skydive here and now the rest of the internet! Thank you for the experience and we will be back!!

If you’re on the fence about skydiving, this is your sign to just freakin’ do it! Tim (my instructor) is a gem. He’s hilarious and helped me feel super comfortable during the whole experience. If I were you, I’d totally request him when going for your jump. I’ll definitely be back soon! Thanks Skydive Philadelphia
This was an amazing adventure and memory from start to finish. I would love to go again sometime, the rush of adrenaline and the amazing views.
Terrifying, exhilarating and incredible! Amazing staff with such a positive high energy level! We couldn't have asked for a better experience!
